anomalies.observed: T2 is an AON6407 P-channel MOSFET, but its pin 2 (source) is connected to the fused input net /+24V_{F} and its pin 3 (drain) is connected to the protected +24V rail.
anomalies.expected: For the reverse-polarity protection implied by the specification/README, a P-channel MOSFET in the 24 V input path should have its source on the protected +24V rail and its drain on the fused input side (/+24V_{F}); this orientation lets the intrinsic body diode and gate zener turn the device on for correct polarity and block reverse polarity.

evidence.quote: README states the PCB includes "reverse polarity protection, TVS diodes, proper isolation"

anomalies.impact: With the source on the input side, the MOSFET body diode conducts when the 24 V supply is reversed, defeating reverse-polarity protection and potentially causing high current, fuse blow, or board damage.

parsed.summary: Most of the netlist matches the intended OPNhydro-r2 architecture, but the input P-channel MOSFET T2 appears to be source/drain reversed for reverse-polarity protection.
